description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractConfigurationProvider' in the AWS SDK for PHP, providing base functionality for configuration providers, including caching, chaining, environment variable handling, and promise-based asynchronous operations.

classes.name: AbstractConfigurationProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for AWS SDK configuration providers, including caching, chaining, environment variable retrieval, and promise handling.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Wraps a configuration provider with caching functionality, storing and retrieving configuration from a cache interface.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Creates a composite configuration provider that invokes multiple providers sequentially until one returns a configuration.

methods.name: getHomeDir
methods.description: Retrieves the user's home directory from environment variables, supporting Unix and Windows.

methods.name: getDefaultConfigFilename
methods.description: Determines the default AWS config file location based on environment variables or default path.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a provider to cache its result, returning the same configuration promise on subsequent calls.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Creates a rejected promise with a standardized exception message.
